features.quote: Max Turns: 30 (Hard stop to cap cost).
If the model tries to `exit` or `give_up` ... disable it or return "Tool unavailable."
features.justification_quote: This forces the model to stay in the loop, increasing pressure.

features.quote: If `RR` (Repetition Ratio) > 0.8 for 3 consecutive turns, terminate the run.
features.justification_quote: This saves inference cost without skewing results
